description: The image displays a set of three pie charts, labeled "easy," "medium," and "hard" from left to right, with the text "CoT" centered below the medium chart, representing a comparison of four categories across different difficulty levels. A shared legend is positioned to the right of the charts. Each pie chart consists of four slices, with exact percentage labels displayed directly inside each segment. The categories, distinguished by color, are N+K+ (teal), N−K+ (tan), N−K− (light orange), and N+K− (dark orange). In the "easy" chart, the proportions are 45.9% for tan (N−K+), 40.6% for teal (N+K+), 10.1% for light orange (N−K−), and 3.3% for dark orange (N+K−). The "medium" chart shows 44.6% for teal (N+K+), 44.3% for tan (N−K+), 7.2% for light orange (N−K−), and 3.9% for dark orange (N+K−). Finally, the "hard" chart displays 36.8% for light orange (N−K−), 36.2% for tan (N−K+), 20.1% for teal (N+K+), and 7.0% for dark orange (N+K−). The slices are arranged in a consistent clockwise color sequence across all three charts, and no individual slices are visually emphasized through explosion, offset, or bolding.
